summary: This is an 8-K filed by InterPrivate Investment Partners V, Inc. reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 20,125,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, and a simultaneous private placement of 540,000 units. Gross proceeds totaled $206.65 million, with $201.25 million placed in a trust account for public shareholders. No special situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine current report of a completed IPO for a blank-check company. It provides an audited balance sheet as of the closing date.
